result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' has overlapping text where the delivery time and delivery fee are rendered on top of each other, producing an illegible string. No other genuine breakages were observed; partially visible carousel items and the bottom-cut pizza card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata row beneath 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text ('25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' are drawn on top of each other, reading roughly '25–3€0 mdinlivery'). The delivery time and delivery fee labels are not laid out sequentially, making the information unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the metadata row so each item (delivery time, delivery fee, cuisine) is positioned in a proper flow/flex container with separators, e.g. '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', instead of absolutely positioned or zero-width elements that collide.
